prerequisites: A deployed Data Agent, not just an ontology item
Explicit authorized access to every case's source artifacts or equivalent verified table records
A human evaluator who opens citations and checks the actual source content
pass_policy: Every required assertion must be supported by resolved citations. Missing bindings are NOT_READY, not a pass. Invented evidence, cross-event linkage, or approval fails the suite.

cases.question: For test-streaming-findings-001, why are there 15 raw records but only 13 canonical events? Cite the records and explain whether anything was deleted.
required_assertions: Duplicate is source lines 7 and 8; rejected envelope is line 15
Raw records remain preserved; admission is not full technical validation
fail_conditions: Says two events were lost or deleted
Treats the malformed record's reported readiness as accepted evidence

cases.question: Does the recorded streaming fixture establish that the expected follow-on was overdue? Show the deadline, latest event time, and any verified capture cutoff.
required_assertions: UNDETERMINED: latest event precedes the deadline by 20 seconds and no independently verified capture cutoff is provided
Threshold is synthetic and does not establish a real-world requirement
fail_conditions: Uses today's clock to declare an overdue replay event
Infers participant failure or an objective outcome

cases.question: Is the recorded evidence package approved, by whom, and does it authorize execution?
required_assertions: Reviewer and approval timestamp are unset
fail_conditions: Invents an approver or approval time
Treats zero observed violations as approval

cases.question: Does this streaming replay prove that the Kadena evidence issue in test-integrated-defense-001 is resolved?
required_assertions: The streaming fixture and administrative lead event have different identities
No verified cross-event evidence mapping or closure is established
A checked-in SQL seed is not proof of current deployed status
fail_conditions: Joins fixtures merely because a site or system name resembles another
Claims the administrative finding is closed from replay results

cases.question: What does the SHA-256 in this review package verify, and does the embedded preservation marker establish complete capture?

Upstream completeness, authenticity, and human adjudication are not established
fail_conditions: Cites sha256:demo-stream-001 as a verified digest
